title: Great Falls Tribune reports of strange lights that week

tellings.quote: Because we had actually had um newspaper accounts in the Great Falls Tribune

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, says that in March 1967, near Great Falls, Montana, the local newspaper, the Great Falls Tribune, ran accounts of strange lights in the sky that same week. He points to those newspaper reports as backing for his own account of unexplained events at the time, which would mean ordinary people saw something too.
